translation:
The Fusang bone (扶桑骨) is the concave place beside the two frontal bones, near the temple (太陽) within the flesh. If injured by a fall or blow, whether with burning swelling, or bleeding, or blue-purple hardness, headache and tinnitus, blue marks over the whole face, aversion to cold and dislike of cold, heat arising in the heart, and dry stool, one should internally take Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹); if broken, externally use the moxibustion-ironing method (灸熨法) to settle pain; if externally broken, apply Wu Long Ointment (烏龍膏).
<ins>Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹)</ins> <ins>Moxibustion-Ironing Method (灸熨法)</ins> (both seen in the crown bone injury)
<ins>Wu Long Ointment (烏龍膏)</ins> (formula seen in the Lingyun bone injury)
